about: A public starter library, written for SecuRAX in plain words, so the control matrix works with no workbook. Regulator documents are cited by name only, never quoted. Which class a control applies to follows its criticality (Critical: MUST for everyone; High: MUST for larger entities, SHOULD for smaller ones; Medium: SHOULD / MAY). It is indicative, not legal advice: check the regulator's own text. Importing your own workbook (./securax controls import) replaces it.

controls.title: A board-approved cyber security policy
controls.description: The board approves a cyber security policy, reviews it every year and names who owns it.

controls.title: A named CISO with direct access to the board

controls.title: Regular cyber reporting to the board
controls.description: The board sees measured posture, top risks and open gaps at least every quarter.

controls.title: Regulatory requirements mapped to controls

controls.title: A cyber risk register
controls.description: Cyber risks are recorded with owner, likelihood, impact, treatment and a due date, and reviewed.

controls.title: Key risk and performance indicators
controls.description: Cyber KRIs and KPIs have thresholds, are measured on a schedule and trigger action when breached.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication for privileged and remote access
controls.description: Admins, remote users and critical systems need a second factor to sign in.

controls.title: Role-based access with least privilege
controls.description: People and systems get only the access their role needs; access is reviewed regularly.

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Logging of privileged and authenticated activity
controls.description: Every privileged action and sign-in is logged with who did it, and the logs are protected.

controls.title: No default or shared credentials
controls.description: Default passwords and shared accounts are removed; secrets are random and rotated.

citations.RBI Primary Citation: RBI IT governance directions (2023); RBI cyber security framework for banks (2016)

controls.title: Strong authentication for APIs
controls.description: Every API checks who is calling, limits what they may do and locks out abuse.

controls.title: An inventory of IT and OT assets
controls.description: Every system, application and device is listed with an owner and how critical it is.

citations.RBI Primary Citation: RBI IT governance directions (2023); RBI cyber security framework for banks (2016)

controls.title: A software bill of materials
controls.description: Third-party and open-source components in each system are known, so a new flaw can be traced fast.

controls.title: An inventory of cryptography
controls.description: Where encryption, keys and certificates are used is listed, with algorithm and expiry.

controls.title: Data loss prevention
controls.description: Sensitive data (customer, card, identity numbers) is detected and stopped from leaving by mistake or abuse.

controls.title: Data localisation for regulated data
controls.description: Data that must stay in India is stored and processed only in India.

controls.title: Controlled cross-border data flows
controls.description: Data leaves the country only when the law and policy allow it, and each transfer is recorded.

controls.title: Encryption in transit
controls.description: Every connection that carries sensitive data is encrypted with current protocols.

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Minimise and mask personal data
controls.description: Only the personal data needed is collected; it is masked wherever full values are not needed.

controls.title: Protected backups
controls.description: Backups are encrypted, tested and kept where an attacker who controls production cannot reach them.

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Network segmentation
controls.description: Critical systems sit in separate network zones; only the traffic that is needed crosses between them.

citations.RBI Primary Citation: RBI IT governance directions (2023); RBI cyber security framework for banks (2016)

controls.title: Secure remote access
controls.description: Remote access goes through an approved, authenticated, encrypted path; never an open port.

controls.title: Endpoint protection on every device
controls.description: Every laptop and server runs managed anti-malware with detection and response.

citations.RBI Primary Citation: RBI IT governance directions (2023); RBI cyber security framework for banks (2016)
citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Hardened standard builds
controls.description: Devices start from an approved, hardened build; deviations are found and fixed.

controls.title: Security testing in the software pipeline
controls.description: Code is scanned for flaws, secrets and risky settings before it is released.

controls.title: Secure, rate-limited APIs
controls.description: Public and partner APIs are authenticated, limited and validated against abuse.

controls.title: Secure code review
controls.description: Changes are reviewed for security before they reach production.

controls.title: Supply-chain checks for software
controls.description: Third-party code and packages are checked before use and pinned to known versions.

controls.title: Dependency vulnerability scanning
controls.description: Libraries and container images are scanned for known flaws on every build.

controls.title: Security headers on web applications
controls.description: Web apps send headers that stop common browser attacks such as framing and script injection.

controls.title: Cloud security posture management
controls.description: Cloud settings are checked continuously against a secure baseline.

controls.title: Hardened containers and workloads
controls.description: Containers run as non-root with limits, from scanned images.

controls.title: Infrastructure-as-code scanning
controls.description: Cloud and infrastructure templates are scanned before they are applied.

controls.title: Third-party risk assessment
controls.description: Vendors with access to systems or data are assessed before onboarding and reviewed each year.

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Incident terms in vendor contracts
controls.description: Contracts require vendors to report incidents fast and to allow audits.

controls.title: Approved cryptographic standards
controls.description: Only approved algorithms and key lengths are used; weak ones are retired on a plan.

controls.title: Post-quantum readiness plan
controls.description: A plan to move to quantum-safe cryptography, starting with data that must stay secret for years.

controls.title: Quantum-safe key exchange at the edge
controls.description: Internet-facing connections offer hybrid post-quantum key exchange where the software supports it.

controls.title: Crypto agility
controls.description: Algorithms can be swapped without rewriting systems.

controls.title: Continuous vulnerability scanning
controls.description: Systems and code are scanned for known flaws on a schedule and after changes.

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Patch known-exploited flaws first
controls.description: Flaws that attackers already use are fixed within a short, fixed deadline.

controls.title: 24x7 security monitoring
controls.description: A security operations centre watches alerts from critical systems around the clock.

citations.RBI Primary Citation: RBI cyber security framework for banks (2016)
citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Threat intelligence feeds

controls.title: Automated triage and playbooks
controls.description: Common alerts are triaged and handled by tested playbooks.

controls.title: Log retention

controls.title: Report incidents to CERT-In on time

controls.title: Report incidents to every regulator on time
controls.description: Each applicable regulator gets its incident report within its own deadline.

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Incident response playbooks
controls.description: Written, tested playbooks for the likely incidents: ransomware, fraud, data leak, outage.

citations.RBI Primary Citation: RBI cyber security framework for banks (2016)
citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Cyber drills
controls.description: The response is rehearsed with realistic drills at least once a year.

citations.RBI Primary Citation: RBI cyber security framework for banks (2016)

controls.title: Lessons learned after incidents

controls.title: Business continuity and recovery targets
controls.description: Critical services have recovery time and data-loss targets, approved by the board.

controls.description: A restore is checked for completeness and integrity before it is trusted.

controls.title: Physical security of data centres

controls.title: Background checks and exit process

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Customer awareness
controls.description: Customers are told how to spot fraud and how to report it.

controls.title: Independent cyber audit
controls.description: An independent auditor checks cyber controls on a fixed schedule.

citations.IRDAI 2023: IRDAI information and cyber security guidelines (2023)

controls.title: Continuous control monitoring
controls.description: Key controls are checked automatically and continuously, not only at audit time.

controls.title: Governance of AI and machine-learning models

controls.title: Advanced software supply-chain assurance
controls.description: Signed, reproducible builds and provenance for critical software.

controls.title: Quantum threat assessment
